description: Search for an MCP server, skill, agent, API or other callable capability for a task, across this index and every other public ARD registry at once. Returns ranked matches with a relevance score, the endpoint to connect to, and which registries carry each result. The score is relevance only and is not a trust or safety rating. Filter by payment (free, payable, x402, mpp) and a maximum price per call: terms come from the publisher's manifest or the endpoint's own 402 answer, and the caller pays the provider directly. 2 free calls a day, then 0.1 USDC per call over x402 (or prepaid credits).

federate.description: Also query upstream registries live and fuse the rankings. Off is faster.

kind.description: Restrict to one family of resource. Matching is normalised, so 'mcp-server' finds them under every media type in circulation, and 'a2a-agent' or 'agent' both reach A2A cards and ACP, OASF and AgentFacts descriptors. 'webmcp' is browser-page tools, which are not callable servers.

max_price_per_call.description: Most you will pay for one call, in US dollars. A resource whose price is unknown is excluded.

network.description: Payment network, for example base, solana, tempo or stripe.

payment.description: Keep only resources with this payment requirement. 'free' means none is known; 'payable' means a price or a 402 is known.

query.description: The task, in plain language. For example: 'scrape a website behind cloudflare'.

name: find_resource
title: Find an agentic resource
